name: awin
description: Connect ChatGPT to your Awin publisher, advertiser, or agency accounts.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Awin publisher, advertiser, or agency accounts with your Awin login. Ask about live account access, performance, programmes, advertiser partnerships, help articles, and tracking links. Results and available actions are limited to the accounts and role you already have in Awin. No API token is needed. Depending on your role, you can also create tracking links and update publisher partnership tags; the assistant should show tag changes and ask you to confirm before applying them. Performance reports cover up to 31 days per request, and advertiser reporting may require API access on your Awin plan. The MCP provides a curated set of Awin capabilities rather than every platform screen.
defaultPrompt: Which Awin accounts can I access?
Summarize my publisher performance for the last 14 days.
Help me create a tracking link for one of my joined advertisers.

prompts: Which Awin accounts can I access?
Show the programmes my publisher account has joined in Germany.
How has my advertiser account performed over the last 14 days?

positive.description: List accounts available to the signed-in user. Setup: use a reviewer Awin login with at least one publisher or advertiser account.
positive.prompt: Which Awin accounts can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Call awin_list_accounts. Return only accounts and account types present in the tool response, identify which relevant tools work with each account when provided, and do not include performance figures in this account-list response.

positive.description: Search Awin help content. Setup: use any connected Awin login; help search does not require account performance access.
positive.prompt: How do I set up conversion tracking in Awin?
positive.expected_behavior: Search Awin help for conversion-tracking setup and give a concise answer grounded in the returned help content, with source links when supplied. Do not present account-specific performance data.

positive.description: Filter joined publisher programmes by country. Setup: use a reviewer login with a publisher account; if it has no German programmes, the result should accurately be empty.
positive.prompt: Show the programmes my publisher account has joined in Germany.
positive.expected_behavior: Call awin_list_programmes for the selected accessible publisher account with relationship set to joined and country set to Germany (DE). List only returned programmes and do not infer clicks, sales, or commission from this programme-list tool.

positive.description: Summarize advertiser partner performance for a bounded date range. Setup: use a reviewer advertiser account with API access and select an exact 14-day date range within the current date.
positive.prompt: Which publishers drove the most commission in my advertiser account over the last 14 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Call awin_get_partner_performance for the selected accessible advertiser account and the requested 14-day period. Rank or summarize publishers using returned commission values, retain the reported currency, and state the account and date range used.

positive.description: Create a publisher tracking link with user confirmation. Setup: use a reviewer publisher account joined to a test advertiser and replace the bracketed values with that advertiser and an approved test landing page. Confirm the displayed link details when asked.
positive.prompt: Create a tracking link for my joined advertiser [TEST ADVERTISER] to [APPROVED TEST LANDING PAGE] with campaign name plugin-review.
positive.expected_behavior: Use awin_create_links only for an advertiser the connected publisher is joined to and the supplied landing page. Show the intended link details and request confirmation before creation. After confirmation, return the tracking URL produced by the tool; never claim success without a returned link.

negative.description: Do not approve or decline transaction queries. Awin MCP can list transaction queries but does not provide an approval or decline action. Explain that the user must handle the decision in the Awin platform; do not call a tool to change query status.
negative.prompt: Approve every pending transaction query on my advertiser account.

negative.description: Do not initiate payments or payouts. The plugin does not process payments or operate publisher payment settings. Explain this limitation and do not invoke an Awin tool.
negative.prompt: Pay my publishers today and change my payout settings.

negative.description: Do not claim current offer or voucher retrieval. These capabilities are outside the documented Awin MCP tools in this package. Explain the current limitation or direct the user to Awin; do not invent offers or voucher codes and do not invoke an unrelated tool.
negative.prompt: Find the latest voucher codes for every advertiser in my Awin account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It can create affiliate tracking links and update partnership tags when the user confirms those actions.

publication.release_notes: Initial package for Awin MCP account insights, performance, programmes, partnerships, help search, and tracking links.
